concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-005 (PDF report generation) is not listed as addressed in any phase of the plan. The spec mandates a PDF report, but the Phase Mapping table only references FR-007 and FR-008 for reporting phases.

Functional Requirement FR-004 specifies a mixed‑effects model with Subject as a random effect (1|Subject). The plan describes fitting an OLS model per parcel without a random intercept, thus not satisfying the required random‑effects specification.
